description: This file defines a PySide6-based GUI widget for displaying and saving pandas DataFrames, including a custom table model and save functionality supporting multiple formats and optional RDS export.

classes.name: DataFrameModel
classes.description: A Qt table model for displaying pandas DataFrame contents in a GUI table view.

classes.name: View_df
classes.description: A QWidget-based GUI component for visualizing a pandas DataFrame and providing options to save it in various formats.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the save operation, allowing the user to choose a file format and filename, then saves the DataFrame accordingly, including optional RDS format if pyreadr is available.
